The D. E. Shaw group is seeking software developers to work on technology that supports the firm’s activities. The role focuses on developing computerized trading strategies, real-time data systems, and tools for advanced mathematical modeling.
Software Developer building computerized trading strategies, real-time distributed data systems, and advanced mathematical modeling tools

Responsibilities:
• Specific responsibilities may include formulating statistical models for our computerized trading strategies, developing distributed systems to analyze and react to incoming data in real time, and creating tools for advanced mathematical modeling

Requirements:
• exceptional software developers with a range of quantitative and programming abilities
• excellent analytical, mathematical, and software design skills
• extensive software development experience

Preferred:
• Successful developers have traditionally been the top students in their programs
